name_reason: Follows data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain=ui_menu). Reflects datatype (pointer to a candidate-id byte array). No Ghidra-address residue in the name; no domain-ID suffix involved. Verified semantics via xrefs (3 game writers + 1 reader): it is the universal scrollable-menu candidate-id byte-array pointer.
purpose: Universal scrollable-menu candidate pointer: holds the address of the byte array of valid candidate ids shown in the currently-active menu/grid, paired with the visible-row count @ 0x5413F.
logic_summary: Each menu opener stores the address of a local byte[32] of candidate ids into this slot (writers: fd2_run_buy_item_menu @0x2F24C = equip-eligible char-id list; fd2_promote_members_select_loop @0x30CAD = promotable-member list for church-revive; fd2_promote_member_select_loop @0x31267 = candidate-class list for class-promotion). The chapter-intro panel renderer fd2_render_chapter_intro_dialog_panels @0x2DC03 (mode 2) reads it back byte-wide as ptr[scroll_offset + i] -- a byte index into the portrait/sprite cache -- to draw the visible 3-icon window. Store at 0x2F24C is MOV [0x54143],EAX with EAX=ESP (address of a stack-local byte[32]), i.e. a single 4-byte pointer slot.
element_semantics: 4-byte pointer to a byte array of candidate ids (each element a char/portrait/class id used as a byte index into the active grid and the portrait/sprite cache).
